# TelepsychHealth

> > TelepsychHealth provides same-day virtual psychiatric and therapy appointments with licensed providers across multiple states, offering medication management, individual therapy, and 24/7 inpatient telepsychiatry services for healthcare facilities.

TelepsychHealth is a telehealth platform specializing in accessible mental healthcare delivery through virtual appointments with psychiatrists and therapists. The platform serves patients across 14+ states and offers specialized B2B inpatient telepsychiatry services for hospitals, detox centers, and residential treatment programs.

## Key Topics

- Telepsychiatry
- Online Psychiatry
- Virtual Mental Health
- Medication Management
- Psychotherapy
- Multi-State Coverage
- Clinical Decision Support
- Inpatient Services
- Insurance Accepted
- Appointment Scheduling
- CBT/DBT Therapy
- Psychiatric Care
- New Patient Intake
- Clozapine Monitoring
- Treatment Algorithms

## Patient Services

- [Home - TelepsychHealth](https://www.telepsychhealth.com): TelepsychHealth homepage offering same-day urgent appointments with psychiatrists and therapists across multiple states.
- [Request Virtual Appointment](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/telepsych-health-online-psychiatrist): New patient intake form for scheduling virtual appointments with psychiatrists and therapists.
- [Routine Medication Management and Individual Therapy](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/routine-medication-management-and-individual-therapy): Service page describing medication management and individual therapy using CBT and DBT.
- [Meet Our Team](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/meet-our-providers): Provider directory featuring psychiatrists, psychologists, and other mental health professionals.

## Institutional Services

- [Inpatient Telepsychiatry Services for Hospitals, Detox & Residential Programs](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/inpatient-telepsychiatry-services-for-hospitals-detox-and-residential-programs): B2B service offering 24/7 inpatient telepsychiatry coverage for hospitals and treatment facilities.

## Regional Services

- [Telepsych Health: Online Psychiatrist Arizona](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/online-psychiatrist-and-therapist-florida-2): Regional service page for online psychiatry in Arizona with insurance and regulatory information.

## Clinical Tools & Resources

- [Clozapine Dose Titration Calculator](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/clozapine-dose-titration-calculator): Interactive clinical tool for estimating clozapine dosing based on patient factors.
- [Clozapine Plasma Concentration Calculator and Interpreter](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/clozapine-plasma-concentration-calculator-and-interpreter): Clinical decision support tool for clozapine therapeutic drug monitoring and dosing.
- [Hypertension Treatment Decision Support App](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/hypertension-treatment-decision-support-app): Evidence-based hypertension treatment algorithm recommending guideline-concordant therapy.
- [- TelepsychHealth](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/courses): Online courses on mental health treatment including CBT, ACT, and telepsychiatry training.

## Information & Support

- [FAQ - TelepsychHealth](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/frequently-asked-questions): Frequently asked questions about telepsychiatry, medication management, and therapy services.

- [Get Support – Mental Health Therapy and Treatment](https://www.telepsychhealth.com/contact-us): Contact form and information for patient support and appointment inquiries.
